title: Separate MCP positive tool tests from remote-access denial tests
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that positive MCP benchmark tests expect HTTP 200 but their TestServer configuration does not enable MemorySmith:AllowRemoteApi, so requests are rejected with 403 before tool contracts execute. Evidence: MemorySmith.Tests/SearchBenchmarkTests.cs lines 293-403 and request guard configuration. Configure positive tests for the intended allowed mode and retain a separate explicit 403 security test.
